posts.name: VanceMadrox
posts.cooked:
So with Vengeance arriving shortly (mine's in already) how are YOU going to divide all your Sentinels goodness between the boxes?

 

I've chosen to have some of each type of deck in both boxes so I can just grab one of the boxes and go.

My Break down:

EE Box:

Heroes (13): Legacy, Bunker, Tachyon, Wraith, Absolute Zero, Tempest, Ra, Haka, Fanatic, Visonary, Unity, Argent Adept, Omnitron X

Villains (10): Baron Blade, Omnitron, Citizen Dawn, Grand Warlord Voss, Plague Rat, Apostate, The Ennead, Akash'bhuta, Iron Legacy, Ambuscade

Environments: Megalopolis, Wagner Mars Base, Insula Primalis, Ruins of Atlantis, Pike Industrial Complex, Tomb of Anubis, Time Cataclysm, The Block

 

Vengeance Box:

Heroes: (10) KNYFE, Naturalist, Parse, Setback, The Sentinels, Chrono-Ranger, The Scholar, ExPatriette, Mr. Fixer, Nightmist

Villains: (8 + V5) Spite, Chairman, Matriarch, Gloomweaver, The Dreamer, La Capitan, Kismet, Miss Information, Vengeful 5

Environments: Rook City, Realm of Discord, Final Wasteland, Silver Gulch, Freedom Tower, Mobile Defense Platform

 

 

 

How are you going to divide everything? By expansion? By Type? Alphabetically?

posts.name: danmarshall14
posts.cooked:
So far, I've split it up like this:

EE Box:

10 Base Heroes on the left side

13 expansion Heroes on the right side

RC/IR Box:

All Villains on the left side

All Environments on the right side

Vengeance Box:

Components! All HP tokens and modifier tokens.  Any extra copies of cards, promos, and dividers.  And of course, the oversized villain cards in their sexy new compartment.

 

I might shift things around (dragging all three boxes around with me when I bring Sentinels to a friend's place will probably be less than optimal).  But for now, it's organized and thematic :)

posts.name: HikariStarshine
posts.cooked:
ruby walters:

i was wondering if you have your cards sleeve will they fit in the vegenace box.

 

I use penny sleeves, and was able to (with slight modifications to the EE box) fit all of my heroes plus two extra Legacy decks into the EE box, all of the villains into the parallel sections of the Vengeance box, and all of the environments into the 'Oversized Card' section of Vengeance, plus two Chessex D10 packs at the ends of the lines in EE and all the tokens (bagged) in with the environments in Vengeance.  Oversized villain cards rest on top of the other villains, rulebooks are stacked on top of EE.

 

That said, I may be looking into the feasibility of getting an RC/IR box when WotC hits.
